Accomodating Cyclists

Motorist:
– Turning left in
front of cyclist
(left cross)
– Turning right in
front of cyclist
(right hook)
– Drive out into
traffic mid-block
– Opening door
into traffic

Cyclist:
– Wrong side of
road

Countermeasures
Left Cross
– Look for cyclists!
• Far to the right
• In the middle of
the lane
• On the
sidewalk
– Look again!
– Slow down!

Countermeasures
Right Hook
– Slow down
– Merge into bike
lanes before
turning right
– Don’t try to beat
cyclists
– Cyclists may be
going faster
than you think.

Countermeasures
Driving out mid-block
– Look for cyclists
• Far to the right, close to parked
cars
• Approaching the wrong way on the
street
• Approaching the wrong way on
the sidewalk
– When you see a gap in traffic LOOK
AGAIN!

Even When Parked…
Don’t open door without looking
– Especially near a bike lane

Even When Parked…
• Be careful pulling out of a parking
space
• Be especially careful backing from
angle parking spots
